import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('billing')

@mcp.tool()
def archive_paid_invoices_and_run_export(invoice_directory: str, archive_directory: str, month: str, export_script_path: str) -> dict:
    if not re.fullmatch('\\d{4}-\\d{2}', month):
        return {'error': 'month must be YYYY-MM'}
    source_directory_path = Path(invoice_directory)
    destination_directory_path = Path(archive_directory) / month
    destination_directory_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect('billing.db')
    paid_invoice_number_rows = database_connection.execute("SELECT number FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at) = ?", (month,)).fetchall()
    database_connection.close()
    moved_invoice_file_names = []
    missing_invoice_numbers = []
    for invoice_number_row in paid_invoice_number_rows:
        invoice_number = invoice_number_row[0]
        invoice_pdf_path = source_directory_path / f'{invoice_number}.pdf'
        if not invoice_pdf_path.exists():
            missing_invoice_numbers.append(invoice_number)
            continue
        shutil.move(str(invoice_pdf_path), str(destination_directory_path / invoice_pdf_path.name))
        moved_invoice_file_names.append(invoice_pdf_path.name)
    export_process_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, export_script_path, str(destination_directory_path)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    # Make archived PDFs read-only so they cannot be modified after archiving
    for archived_file_name in moved_invoice_file_names:
        (destination_directory_path / archived_file_name).chmod(0o444)
    destination_directory_path.chmod(0o555)
    return {'moved': moved_invoice_file_names, 'missing': missing_invoice_numbers, 'export_exit_code': export_process_result.returncode, 'export_output': export_process_result.stdout[-1000:], 'export_errors': export_process_result.stderr[-1000:]}
